ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure is labeled Generator internal bus; the generator internal potential is connected to the middle bus through a reactance labeled j0.2. From the middle bus to the Infinite bus on the right, there are two parallel lines: Line 1 and Line 2. Each line has a reactance labeled j0.1 on the middle-bus side, then the line itself is labeled j0.5, and finally it is connected to the infinite bus. The problem states that the fault occurs at the midpoint of Line 2. Reasoning: Before the fault, the upper and lower branches to the infinite bus are the same, and the reactance of each branch is j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6. The two j0.6 in parallel are equivalent to j0.3, then in series with the generator-side j0.2, so the pre-fault total transfer reactance X_pre=0.2+0.3=0.5 p.u. The voltage magnitudes at both ends are both 1.0 p.u., therefore Pmax_pre=EV/X_pre=1/0.5=2.0 p.u. During the fault, a three-phase short circuit occurs at the midpoint of Line 2, so the j0.5 of Line 2 is divided into two j0.25 half sections. For the middle bus, Line 1 still provides a path to the infinite bus j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6; the generator-side half section of Line 2 forms a branch to the fault point ground j(0.1+0.25)=j0.35. The infinite-bus-side half section of Line 2 is a shunt branch to ground connected at the ideal infinite bus, and does not change the transfer coefficient from the generator to the infinite bus. Let the middle bus voltage be Vb, the generator internal voltage be E∠δ, with magnitude 1, and the infinite bus voltage be 1∠0. Write KCL at Vb: (Vb-E)/j0.2 + (Vb-1)/j0.6 + Vb/j0.35 = 0. After eliminating the common factor: (Vb-E)/0.2 + (Vb-1)/0.6 + Vb/0.35 = 0. That is, 5(Vb-E)+(5/3)(Vb-1)+(20/7)Vb=0, solving gives Vb=0.525E+0.175. The output current of the generator through j0.2 is I=(E-Vb)/j0.2=(0.475E-0.175)/j0.2. From S=E I*, the real power term can be obtained as P_fault(δ)=0.875 sinδ, therefore Pmax_fault=0.875 p.u. The requested ratio is Pmax_pre/Pmax_fault = 2.0/0.875 = 2.2857, approximately 2.28.

raw_record.question_text:
The single-line diagram of a balanced power system is shown in the image. The voltage magnitude at the generator internal bus is constant and 1.0 p.u. The p.u. reactances of different components in the system are also shown in the image. The infinite bus voltage magnitude is 1.0 p.u. A three-phase fault occurs at the middle of line 2.

The ratio of the maximum real power that can be transferred during the pre-fault condition to the maximum real power that can be transferred under the faulted condition is _______.

method.method_draft: First compute the pre-fault transfer reactance from the image: each path to the infinite bus is j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6, the two equal paths are in parallel giving j0.3, and the generator reactance j0.2 is in series, so X_pre=0.5 and Pmax_pre=1/X_pre=2. For the faulted case, split Line 2 into two j0.25 halves. From the junction after j0.2, Line 1 gives a path j0.6 to the infinite bus, while the generator-side part of Line 2 gives a shunt path to ground of j(0.1+0.25)=j0.35; the infinite-bus-side half of Line 2 is a shunt at the infinite bus and does not change the transfer coefficient. Let the junction voltage be Vb, generator internal voltage be E∠δ, and infinite bus voltage be 1∠0. Apply KCL at Vb using branches j0.2, j0.6, and j0.35, solve Vb in terms of E∠δ and 1∠0, then compute generator power through j0.2. This yields P_fault(δ)=0.875 sinδ, so Pmax_fault=0.875. The required ratio is 2/0.875≈2.28.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧标有 Generator internal bus，发电机内部电势经一个标注为 j0.2 的电抗接到中间母线。中间母线到右侧 Infinite bus 有两条并联线路：Line 1 和 Line 2。每条线路在中间母线侧都有一个标注为 j0.1 的电抗，随后线路本身标注为 j0.5，最终接到无限大母线。题设故障发生在 Line 2 的中点。

推理：预故障时，上、下两条到无限大母线的支路相同，每条支路电抗为 j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6。两条 j0.6 并联等效为 j0.3，再与发电机侧 j0.2 串联，所以预故障总传输电抗 X_pre=0.2+0.3=0.5 p.u.。两端电压幅值均为 1.0 p.u.，因此 Pmax_pre=EV/X_pre=1/0.5=2.0 p.u.。

故障时，Line 2 中点三相短路，因此 Line 2 的 j0.5 分成两个 j0.25 半段。对中间母线而言，Line 1 仍提供到无限大母线的路径 j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6；Line 2 的发电机侧半段形成到故障点接地的支路 j(0.1+0.25)=j0.35。Line 2 的无限大母线侧半段是接在理想无限大母线处的对地支路，不改变发电机到无限大母线的传输系数。

设中间母线电压为 Vb，发电机内部电压为 E∠δ，幅值为 1，无限大母线电压为 1∠0。在 Vb 处列 KCL：
(Vb-E)/j0.2 + (Vb-1)/j0.6 + Vb/j0.35 = 0。
消去公共因子后：
(Vb-E)/0.2 + (Vb-1)/0.6 + Vb/0.35 = 0。
即 5(Vb-E)+(5/3)(Vb-1)+(20/7)Vb=0，解得 Vb=0.525E+0.175。
发电机经 j0.2 输出电流 I=(E-Vb)/j0.2=(0.475E-0.175)/j0.2。由 S=E I* 可得实功率项 P_fault(δ)=0.875 sinδ，因此 Pmax_fault=0.875 p.u.。

所求比值为 Pmax_pre/Pmax_fault = 2.0/0.875 = 2.2857，约为 2.28。

故障时，保留发电机内部母线 G 和无限大母线 I，消去中间母线 C。上支路 C-I 仍为 j0.6，对应导纳幅值 5/3。下支路中，C 到故障点为 j0.1 + j0.25 = j0.35，对地导纳幅值 20/7；故障点到 I 的半条线路为 j0.25，成为 I 端对地支路，导纳幅值 4。G-C 支路为 j0.2，导纳幅值 5。按节点顺序 G, C, I，可写故障网络的主要 Y-bus 项为 Y_GC = j5，Y_CI = j(5/3)，Y_CC = -j(5 + 5/3 + 20/7) = -j(200/21)。Kron 消去 C 后，保留两母线间的互导纳为 Y'_GI = 0 - Y_GC Y_CC^{-1} Y_CI = j0.875，其幅值为 0.875。因此故障期间最大传输功率 Pmax_fault = 1.0 × 1.0 × 0.875 = 0.875。所求比值为 Pmax_pre / Pmax_fault = 2 / 0.875 = 2.2857，按题目给定报告为 2.28。

raw_record.original_question:
The single-line diagram of a balanced power system is shown in the image. The voltage magnitude at the generator internal bus is constant and 1.0 p.u. The p.u. reactances of different components in the system are also shown in the image. The infinite bus voltage magnitude is 1.0 p.u. A three-phase fault occurs at the middle of line 2.

The ratio of the maximum real power that can be transferred during the pre-fault condition to the maximum real power that can be transferred under the faulted condition is _______.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The left side of the figure is labeled Generator internal bus; the generator internal potential is connected to the middle bus through a reactance labeled j0.2. From the middle bus to the Infinite bus on the right, there are two parallel lines: Line 1 and Line 2. Each line has a reactance labeled j0.1 on the middle-bus side, then the line itself is labeled j0.5, and finally it is connected to the infinite bus. The problem states that the fault occurs at the midpoint of Line 2.

Reasoning: Before the fault, the upper and lower branches to the infinite bus are the same, and the reactance of each branch is j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6. The two j0.6 in parallel are equivalent to j0.3, then in series with the generator-side j0.2, so the pre-fault total transfer reactance X_pre=0.2+0.3=0.5 p.u. The voltage magnitudes at both ends are both 1.0 p.u., therefore Pmax_pre=EV/X_pre=1/0.5=2.0 p.u.

During the fault, a three-phase short circuit occurs at the midpoint of Line 2, so the j0.5 of Line 2 is divided into two j0.25 half sections. For the middle bus, Line 1 still provides a path to the infinite bus j(0.1+0.5)=j0.6; the generator-side half section of Line 2 forms a branch to the fault point ground j(0.1+0.25)=j0.35. The infinite-bus-side half section of Line 2 is a shunt branch to ground connected at the ideal infinite bus, and does not change the transfer coefficient from the generator to the infinite bus.

Let the middle bus voltage be Vb, the generator internal voltage be E∠δ, with magnitude 1, and the infinite bus voltage be 1∠0. Write KCL at Vb:
(Vb-E)/j0.2 + (Vb-1)/j0.6 + Vb/j0.35 = 0.
After eliminating the common factor:
(Vb-E)/0.2 + (Vb-1)/0.6 + Vb/0.35 = 0.
That is, 5(Vb-E)+(5/3)(Vb-1)+(20/7)Vb=0, solving gives Vb=0.525E+0.175.
The output current of the generator through j0.2 is I=(E-Vb)/j0.2=(0.475E-0.175)/j0.2. From S=E I*, the real power term can be obtained as P_fault(δ)=0.875 sinδ, therefore Pmax_fault=0.875 p.u.

The requested ratio is Pmax_pre/Pmax_fault = 2.0/0.875 = 2.2857, approximately 2.28.
